newsitem.title: UK: Emerging debt unchanged to firmer, awaits U.S. ECI.
newsitem.headline: Emerging debt unchanged to firmer, awaits U.S. ECI.

text.p: Emerging market debt prices were unchanged to slightly firmer on Tuesday but activity remained extremely thin ahead of the U.S. employment cost index (ECI) due out today, traders said.
"Everyone is really waiting on the ECI later on and I expect it to remain quiet ahead of that," said one Brady bond trader at a major U.S. bank in London.
The Brady market, which tightened five to 10 basis points on Monday, is expected to remain rangebound ahead of second quarter ECI data and the July consumer confidence report, trading sources added.
Though the Brady market remained slightly cautious ahead of the ECI data, traders said any negative news would trigger a bout of profit-taking followed by a round of buying on weakness.

"Our view is to buy on dips. If it comes out reasonably negative, I think we will see dips with profit-taking but then some of the larger players should come in and fill up positions," a head trader at a European bank said.
One chief Brady bond trader said the Philippine debt instruments, along with Mexican and Argentine globals were among the most actively traded issues in the early London session.
He attributed local bank buying of Philippine debt to the rise in the country's debt assets.
Philippines' DCB PHDCB=RR were 1/8 firmer at95-3/4 bid and the country's pars PH425L18=RR were 1/8 better at 65-3/4 bid.
Meanwhile, Mexican UMS-26 MXUMS=RR were 1/4 stronger at 120-5/8 and Argentine global-17 ARGLB17=RR were unchanged at 117-5/8 bid.
In the Eastern European Brady market, prices were mostly firmer across the board.
Spreads on Poland's debt, which had widened initially on news in the past weeks of heavy flooding, continued to tighten with the rest of the market.
"Poland has been trading up and down. It initially widened but it has been slowly tightening with the turn in the rest of the market," said a trader.
On a price basis, Poland's par bonds PO275024=RR were 1/4 higher at 60-1/4 bid and its PDI bonds PO325024=RR were 1/8 better at 87-1/4 bid.
